marienplatz.name: Marienplatz
marienplatz.hours: Square always open · Glockenspiel plays daily around 11:00 and 12:00, also 17:00 in summer
marienplatz.tip: Arrive a few minutes early and stand on the north side for the best view of the Glockenspiel.

nymphenburg.name: Nymphenburg Palace
nymphenburg.price_text: ≈ EUR 10–15 for the palace; park free; check combined tickets on the day
nymphenburg.hours: Palace roughly 09:00–18:00 in summer, shorter in winter · closed some Mondays, check on the day
nymphenburg.tip: The park is free and huge. Allow extra time to walk to the small pavilions.

english-garden.name: English Garden
english-garden.hours: Always open · beer gardens have their own hours
english-garden.tip: Walk from the Chinese Tower to the Eisbach surfers for a free half-day loop.
english-garden.best: Sunny afternoon; summer for the surfers

residenz.name: Munich Residenz
residenz.price_text: ≈ EUR 9–12 for the museum; treasury separate; check on the day
residenz.hours: Roughly 09:00–18:00, closed some public holidays · check on the day
residenz.tip: The treasury is the highlight for many visitors. Buy the combined ticket if you have time.

neues-rathaus.name: Neues Rathaus
neues-rathaus.price_text: Free to view from outside; tower lift small fee, check on the day
neues-rathaus.hours: Exterior always visible · tower has limited hours, check on the day
neues-rathaus.tip: The tower lift gives a good rooftop view over the old town.

allianz-arena.name: Allianz Arena
allianz-arena.price_text: ≈ EUR 12–20 for a stadium tour; match tickets vary widely
allianz-arena.hours: Tour times vary by match schedule · check on the day
allianz-arena.tip: Book a tour online. On match days the area is very busy and tours may stop.
allianz-arena.best: Weekday tour; avoid match days if you only want the tour

oktoberfest.name: Oktoberfest
oktoberfest.price_text: Free to enter the grounds; beer and food paid separately
oktoberfest.hours: Late September to early October · tents open from morning to late evening
oktoberfest.tip: Go on a weekday morning for easier tent entry. Weekends are packed.

bmw-welt.name: BMW Welt & Museum
bmw-welt.price_text: ≈ EUR 10 for the museum; BMW Welt free; check on the day
bmw-welt.hours: Museum roughly 10:00–18:00, closed Mondays · check on the day
bmw-welt.tip: BMW Welt is free and good for a quick look even if you skip the museum.

bavaria-filmstadt.name: Bavaria Filmstadt
bavaria-filmstadt.price_text: ≈ EUR 12–18 for the guided tour; check on the day
bavaria-filmstadt.hours: Roughly 09:00–18:00 in summer, shorter in winter · check on the day
bavaria-filmstadt.tip: It is outside the centre. Allow half a day including travel.

cuvillies.name: Cuvilliés Theatre
cuvillies.hours: Limited hours, often tied to the Residenz · check on the day
cuvillies.tip: Small and quick. Combine it with the Residenz next door.

dachau.name: Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial Site
dachau.price_text: Free entry; guided tours and audio guides cost extra
dachau.hours: Roughly 09:00–17:00, closed some Mondays · check on the day
dachau.tip: Take the S-Bahn to Dachau and then the bus. Allow at least half a day and keep it quiet and respectful.

deutsches-museum.name: Deutsches Museum
deutsches-museum.tip: It is huge. Pick two or three sections before you go in.

erdinger.name: Erdinger Weissbräu
erdinger.price_text: Brewery tours and tastings vary; check on the day
erdinger.tip: It is in Erding, well outside Munich. Only go if you really want the brewery tour.

herkulessaal.name: Herkulessaal
herkulessaal.price_text: ≈ EUR 20–60 depending on the concert; check on the day
herkulessaal.tip: It is inside the Residenz. Book tickets online and arrive early for the hall itself.

hofbrauhaus.name: Hofbräuhaus München
hofbrauhaus.price_text: ≈ EUR 12–20 for a main dish and a beer
hofbrauhaus.hours: Roughly 09:00–24:00 daily · check on the day
hofbrauhaus.tip: Very touristy but worth one visit. Share a long table and expect noise.
hofbrauhaus.best: Late afternoon; avoid peak dinner hours

lmu.name: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich
lmu.hours: Outdoor campus area open; buildings have their own hours
lmu.tip: Walk past the main building and the nearby White Rose memorial plaque.

paulaner.name: Paulaner Brewery
paulaner.price_text: ≈ EUR 12–20 for a tour; check on the day
paulaner.tip: Book ahead. The brewery is south of the centre, not in the old town.

sense8.name: Sense8
sense8.price_text: Prices vary; check on the day
sense8.hours: Show times vary; check on the day
sense8.tip: Details are unclear. Confirm the venue and dates before you plan around it.

tum.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
tum.tip: Not a main sight. Skip unless you have a reason to visit.

viktualienmarkt.name: Viktualienmarkt
viktualienmarkt.price_text: Free to enter; food paid separately
viktualienmarkt.hours: Roughly Mon–Sat daytime, closed Sundays · check on the day
viktualienmarkt.tip: Go hungry. Grab a snack and eat at the beer garden in the middle.

frauenkirche-tower.name: Frauenkirche towers
frauenkirche-tower.price_text: ≈ EUR 3–5 for the tower lift; check on the day
frauenkirche-tower.tip: The lift is quick and the view over Marienplatz is good. No lift on some days.

olympiapark.name: Olympiapark and Olympiaturm
olympiapark.price_text: Park free; tower ≈ EUR 8–12; check on the day
olympiapark.hours: Park always open · tower roughly 09:00–24:00 in summer, check on the day
olympiapark.tip: The tower gives the best wide view of the city and the Alps on clear days.

eisbach-surfers.name: Eisbach surfers
eisbach-surfers.tip: Watch from the bank. Do not stand in the water; the current is strong.

glockenbachviertel.name: Glockenbachviertel walk
glockenbachviertel.hours: Always open; cafés and bars have their own hours
glockenbachviertel.tip: Wander the side streets for cafés and small shops. Good in the evening.

third-wave-coffee-tour.name: Old town walking tour
third-wave-coffee-tour.price_text: ≈ EUR 10–20 for a paid tour; free tours tip-based
third-wave-coffee-tour.hours: Tours usually start morning and early afternoon
third-wave-coffee-tour.tip: Book a small-group tour for your first day to get your bearings.
